committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects the GAO, federal agencies providing cybersecurity programs, and small business owners.
dimensions.evidence: The Comptroller General of the United States shall conduct a study of current Federal cybersecurity initiatives... intended to assist owners of small business concerns

dimensions.assessment: Conducts an evaluation and issues a report with findings and recommendations, rather than establishing operational programs.
dimensions.evidence: The Comptroller General shall submit to the Committee on Small Business of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship of the Senate a report

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly states that no funds are authorized to be appropriated to carry out the Act.
dimensions.evidence: No such funds are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Limited to a one-time GAO study and report concerning existing federal programs.
dimensions.evidence: The Comptroller General of the United States shall conduct a study of current Federal cybersecurity initiatives

dimensions.assessment: Temporary effect ending with the completion and submission of the study report.
dimensions.evidence: The Comptroller General shall submit... a report containing all findings and determinations made in carrying out the study

missing_information: Specific timeline or deadline for the GAO report completion
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Government Accountability Office (GAO) to conduct a study and submit a report evaluating federal cybersecurity assistance programs for small businesses, with no new funds authorized.
